blocks.text: Clarence Villaflor and Lanz Zafra ensured that the inaugural UAAP men's singles badminton title would remain with National University after dispatching their respective opponents in the Season 89 individual events semifinals on Monday at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
